simple.meaning: a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּדִישׁ (H1430) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּדִישׁ (gâdîysh) means a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb First listed occurrence: Exod 22 5.

definitions.short: a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb
definitions.full: H1430. gadiysh I. גָּדִישׁ noun masculine Job 5:26 heap, stack (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic id. ) — גָּדִישׁ Exod 22:5 3 t.; — stack of sheaves 22:5 ; Judg 15:5 (|| קָמָה in both) Job 5:26 . II. גּדשׁ (= *; exact meaning unknown). II. גָּדִישׁ noun [masculine] tomb (Arabic id. ) Job 21:32 ; Dr § 178, ed. 3, p. 229 suggests reading גֶּדֶשׁ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to heap up);
